title: A Permissive Permission Block
description: A configuration-file block that sets every permission to allow, switching off an agent's gates for every session until you change it back.

steps.description: This is a permissive `permission` block, the configuration-file way to switch off an agent's gates. It applies to every session until you change it back.
`permission` holds the rules. Its value is an object that maps each permission name to a decision.
The key `"*"` matches every permission, and the value `"allow"` approves each one, so the agent stops asking.

steps.question: The page compares this block with the `--auto` flag. Which of the two is the safer choice, because it expires when the command does?
